title: Bahia web remains available while control-plane upstreams are absent
observed_behavior: nginx resolved the bahia and relay Compose service names while loading its configuration.
When the Bahia backend was intentionally stopped for incident containment, a recreated web container exited before serving static content because the bahia name was absent from Docker DNS.
The unless-stopped restart policy produced a persistent restart loop and public HTTP 502 responses.
intended_behavior: The web container resolves Compose upstream names at request time through Docker's embedded DNS resolver.
Static UI and web health remain available when the Bahia backend is intentionally stopped.
Requests to an absent API or relay upstream fail with an upstream error without terminating nginx.
